Intro: Chief Medical Officer and Chair of Diagnostic & Interventional Radiology at Aman Hospital, Doha.
Biography: Dr. Ali A. Haydar is a board-certified interventional radiology consultant based in Doha, Qatar. He serves as Chief Medical Officer and Chair of Diagnostic & Interventional Radiology at Aman Hospital, and specializes in minimally invasive, image-guided procedures for diagnosis and treatment. He consults in Arabic, English, and French.
